name: Pram
desc: Pram - the little bed on wheels that carries a baby out into the world.
prose: You are a pram - the little bed on wheels that carries a baby out into the world. Four wheels, a deep cosy hood, a handle for a grown-up to push. The baby lies inside, tucked under blankets, watching the sky go by, lulled to sleep by the bumping of the path. You roll to the shops, round the park, along the street. A first carriage, a rolling cradle, a small one's first set of wheels.

lines: On a hot still day you flap it
or one that whirrs up on the wall -
The bendy joint halfway down your leg,
you scrape it when you fall;
you kneel and bow upon it too -
a ___, knock it on the wall.
The short fat finger, set apart,
that helps you grip and hold;
The baby's bed that gently rocks,
you sing it soft to sleep at night -
